Title: Azure AD Conditional Access: Managed browser support for iOS/Android platforms now in preview

Body.Content: This feature adds browser support when using application-based conditional access on iOS and Android in the Azure portal. With this condition, admins can now restrict browser access to services so that only the Intune Managed browser which supports Intune app protection policies can use them. To learn more, read the full blog post and visit our documentation today!
